quotes.text: A story is not a line to be followed, but a garden to be wandered; the truest paths are those the reader discovers for themselves.
quotes.author: Eleanor Vance

quotes.text: Do not write to fill a page with ink, but to carve a space in a reader's memory where your words can live long after the book is closed.
quotes.author: Julian Thorne

quotes.text: The most powerful character you will ever write is the silence between your sentences—the breath where imagination takes root.
quotes.author: Cassandra Reed

quotes.text: A writer's courage is measured not by the villains they create, but by the truths they dare to let their heroes discover.
quotes.author: Alistair Finch
